paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Indonesia
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the distribution of counts associated with polarity scores for Indonesia. The x-axis, labeled “Polarity scores,” ranges from -1.0 to 0.6 with a linear scale and tick intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “Counts,” extends from 0 to approximately 35000, with tick intervals of 5000. A single blue line represents the data, starting at a count of approximately 5000 at a polarity score of -1.0 and reaching a peak count of approximately 60000 at a polarity score of 0.0, before decreasing to approximately 15000 at a polarity score of 0.2, and then continuing to decrease to approximately 5000 at a polarity score of 0.6.
